brief:
Voters at Shaqib al-Salam, a Bedouin town in Israel's Southern District, reported waiting more than four hours to cast ballots, according to Middle East Eye. Lengthy queues formed with some voters leaving before voting due to the extended wait times.

The polling delays affected Palestinian Bedouin communities participating in the election, with hundreds gathering at the single voting location in the town.

title: Palestinian Bedouins endure four-hour waits to vote in Shaqib al-Salam
